description.text: The fifth and last expansion pack of the Pokémon Card e series, released in Japan on 4 October 2002. Its story ends at an ancient temple among three mountains at the center of the continent, with a caldera lake and waterfalls nearby. It brought Pokémon that can use a Poké-Power as they evolve, new Special Energy, and three secret Crystal Type Pokémon: Charizard, Crobat and Celebi. With Split Earth it became the English Skyridge in May 2003.
